_meta.purpose: Indicative relative price band per PIN, anchored to government circle/collector rates (the legal minimum valuation for property registration, used for stamp duty).
_meta.disclaimer: This is the GOVERNMENT MINIMUM VALUATION (circle/collector rate), NOT the market price. Actual market rates are typically higher and vary widely. A single PIN can span cheaper and pricier pockets; the tier reflects the area's typical band, not any one street. Tiers are relative across tracked NCR pins, not an absolute cross-state rupee comparison (states compute circle rates on different bases).
_meta.note_rate_sqm: circle_rate_sqm is populated only where an official per-sqm residential-land figure exists on a comparable basis (Delhi MCD categories; Noida sector categories). Null elsewhere because those states publish rates per sq-yard / per-acre / by licensed-colony, which are not directly comparable per-sqm.
